body: can confirm. having the same issue with tippy 4.2.6 on >13.4.10 as well. downgrading to =13.4.9 fixed it.

I'm experiencing this as well. It broke after upgrading the Next.js version and it works on development but not in production. Tippy's author also confirmed that this looks like a minification issue on Next.js https://github.com/atomiks/tippyjs-react/issues/379

Hi,

Disabling swcMinify fixes the issue:

- https://nextjs.org/docs/architecture/nextjs-compiler#minification

Which leads me to believe this is an issue with SWC, as [this playground](https://play.swc.rs/?version=1.3.71&code=H4sIAAAAAAAAA02OvQrDMAyEdz%2BFRgdCSn%2Bm0GTrXrqGDK0jpwbXCrZcCiXvXjvpEE0fd8fpFLnAMNk4GgcNfAUA01TDvkxkUXMNh4zejM%2FEx8wPYqZXDadSzELgZyLPoKNTbMjBlYLJcEM3oJfF0gkx4EVrVCyT0rSrmE5t%2Foc0oFuxr5Kh7iy7vtgkyWJlaZT%2F%2FGLNhcj7kKN3cB7MG3Zt3iV%2BhE9Hk9sAAAA%3D&config=H4sIAAAAAAAAA32VwXLjIAyG73mKjM%2B99rIPsLc%2BA0OMcMhi5EEijaeTd19BnNRt5Fw89v8hCSQhf%2B32%2B%2B5Effdn%2FyWv8jHZTJAf36LQnNheROl4noD6HCbu3u6UqSLOBZpyvYGOs03kMY9rTxlsz3dhEa8%2FzWweoC7pgN6XIF1EJFiCLNIYUvDz2neP45SBaKWJKu7KCImr7G0keFuzjJ%2F0w2%2FTD4gRZPfbxFgyITEMkDXHPcZoJwJztlnxUndqcyDUQlRYGJyZMk4qTy5wwCQxn6kD60yPDhQUMvQczqCZSSwxSyTHU87TsINDGYbWGb%2Bs4WxjsazEhEsriexW8XrEQGx8SVoKb3AjBze4JPe3ZfAmA5ecnu1OGNJGTf4BSAaiJUp2BM1vW%2BGln7as%2FUvLkLy0LM8Kl%2FbWTplgkKSaELyS2ZoZyBy0amZwpYea2V7bzoI30kfBgQHvpVcU1%2FQZuD9qQetoQK8Aqa%2F1WlfdgHncwg1eL8QL%2FFdOyXqDLStGy8dtSvN4wPgiwAh8RPdigZSCcRtnmRKXaZuX5EBaA5y6pFADz0NALgCjiW1WPvWGXA%2FxaIaIh%2B8x8Txv26ML9IGuxHWTdeNdWX4Ktbp1KEsxRkwn6h7Wj0Hc9r677v4DNkYPd1IGAAA%3D), somewhat shows.

What happens is that the className plugin from tippy gets resolved to an empty object when minifying, and there's no `fn` property on such empty object.

- https://github.com/atomiks/tippyjs-react/blob/master/src/className-plugin.js

I guess the course of action here is to track these (?):

- https://github.com/swc-project/swc/issues/7700
- https://github.com/swc-project/swc/issues/7710

And this, already closed, but related issue: https://github.com/vercel/next.js/issues/53096

issue.title: Plugins error (even though not loading any plugins)
issue.body:
I am getting the following error:

```
2961-809c1f3bec2099a2.js:1 TypeError: e.fn is not a function
    at 4196-45a1ea360224e18c.js:1:31229
    at Array.map (<anonymous>)
    at 4196-45a1ea360224e18c.js:1:31204
    at 4196-45a1ea360224e18c.js:1:37405
    at Array.reduce (<anonymous>)
    at eZ (4196-45a1ea360224e18c.js:1:27992)
    at 4196-45a1ea360224e18c.js:1:1643
    at ap (bce60fc1-0399b9eba6931719.js:9:68389)
    at ah (bce60fc1-0399b9eba6931719.js:9:68449)
    at ay (bce60fc1-0399b9eba6931719.js:9:68888)
```

Looking into the tippy.js repo code, I saw that [this line](https://github.com/atomiks/tippyjs/blob/ad85f6feb79cf6c5853c43bf1b2a50c4fa98e7a1/src/createTippy.ts#L136C1-L137C1) has to do with plugins. I am not loading any plugins with tippy, so I'm not sure why it is trying to call fn() on a plugin. I saw that the `@tippyjs-react` library does load some of its own plugins, so maybe there is an issue there?

I wasn't having this issue prior, but started seeing it pop up now after I upgraded Next version 13.4.9 -> 13.4.10.
